limitations: No target execution, subprocess or network occurred in this comparison.
Old artifact verifiers and archived JSONL parser/MPT/RLP primitives are reused; this is not an independent execution or wholly independent parser.
Old proof replies are joined to raw collector records and full initial allocation facts by the retained verifier, not independently re-walked here.
EELS source, venv, stdlib and Python files are external inventoried dependencies, checked at these recorded paths; OS libraries are not archived.
Root Node failures in the original capture remain preserved; only the explicitly separate root-wrapper observations supply root product/EthereumJS comparisons.
Unsupported product rollback roots are not execution predictions and all product comparison channels remain null for those cases.
TransactionEnd gas includes preparation/spill and is not compared to Geth root-frame gas. Charged gas and max(block execution gas, block state gas) are distinct channels.
Six known synthetic development inputs do not establish a canonical winner, all-fork coverage, deployed-chain reachability or population accuracy.
